QF.id: Issue Management - General Obligations and Due Diligence_16

question.text: Within how many days of issue closure must the devolvement notice be sent to underwriters?

explanation.text: The Logic: The post-issue lead merchant banker must send the devolvement notice to underwriters within 10 days of issue closure. This notice informs underwriters of their obligation to subscribe to the unsubscribed portion, triggering their underwriting commitment. The Trap: "7 days" is the post-issue report deadline for public issues, not the devolvement notice deadline. "3 days" is the initial post-issue report deadline for rights issues. Each deadline serves a different purpose — do not conflate them. Note: Devolvement is a high-stakes event because it activates the underwriters' commitment to subscribe to the unsubscribed portion of the issue.
